zh: 高丽大学（Korea University）成立于1905年，位于韩国首尔市，是韩国顶尖的私立研究型大学，也是SKY联盟成员之一。学校在法学、经济学、政治学、工程、医学等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居韩国前列。高丽大学以其严谨的学术传统和优秀的教学质量，培养了大量韩国社会各界的领袖人才。
en: Korea University, founded in 1905, is a leading private research university in Seoul, South Korea, and a member of the SKY alliance. It excels in law, economics, political science, engineering, medicine, and more, with leading academic research in Korea. Known for its rigorous academic tradition and excellent teaching quality, Korea University has produced numerous leaders in Korean society.
